Want to know where the next big career opportunities could be?

Don’t just watch who is hiring.

Watch who is getting funded.

Because when investors put hundreds of millions into a company, they’re not just betting on that business.

They’re betting on a market they believe is about to get much bigger.

I looked at some of the biggest funding rounds announced this week.

Here are 6 companies that raised serious money this week:

1. Etched: $700M | $21B valuation
AI chips and inference infrastructure.
Jobs: https://lnkd.in/deBZtQ9U

2. Rillet:  $100M Series C | $1B valuation
AI-native accounting and ERP.
Jobs: https://lnkd.in/ds7Brf5F

3. Navi: $100M | ~$1.3B valuation
Fintech.
